name_km: កម្មវិធីអាហារូបករណ៍ថ្នាក់សញ្ជាតិ ក្រសួងអប់រំ យុវជន និងកីឡា
org: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS)
note: The Ministry announces thousands of full undergraduate scholarships every year (8,619 were announced for 2023-24). Check the Ministry's site or your school each year for the current announcement, eligibility, and deadline — the program changes annually so verify before relying on it.

name_km: អាហារូបករណ៍ទេពកោសល្យឌីជីថលតេជោ
note: Government-funded full bachelor's scholarships (hundreds awarded for 2025-26) in digital fields — networking/telecommunications, computer science, cybersecurity, software engineering, AI, and digital business — at partner schools including CADT, ITC, RUPP, NUM, and AUPP. Requires passing a competitive exam (math, logic, English) plus an interview; students from disadvantaged backgrounds, remote areas, and female applicants are especially encouraged. Check mptc.gov.kh or cadt.edu.kh each year, since intake size and partner schools can change.

name_km: អាហារូបករណ៍សមាគមសិស្ស-និស្សិត អ.ម.ត
name_en: AMT Scholarship (Samdech Techo Hun Sen & Kittiprittbandit Scholarship Association)
org: សមាគមសិស្ស-និស្សិតអាហារូបករណ៍ អ.ម.ត (AMT)
note: Around 100 full scholarships awarded yearly to students who scored Grade A, B, or C on the national high school exam and come from low-income families, covering tuition at partner universities (e.g. AUPP). Apply through AMT directly (amt.scholarship.office@gmail.com, Telegram @AMTscholarships) or a partner university's admissions office — verify the current intake and partner schools each year.

name_km: កម្មវិធីអាហារូបករណ៍ធនាគារ Maybank កម្ពុជា
note: Full scholarship for 1st- or 2nd-year undergraduates studying business/banking-related or digital-related majors at selected Cambodian universities, for students with household income under roughly $24,000/year. Applications typically open once a year around March-April — check Maybank's site for the current cycle and deadline.

name_km: កម្មវិធីអាហារូបករណ៍ថ្នាក់ឧត្តមសិក្សា សម្រាប់សិស្សស្រី
name_en: Cambodia Tertiary Scholarship Program (for young women)
org: The Asia Foundation, in partnership with KAPE
note: Supports female students from vulnerable families (historically focused on Kampong Cham province) with financial support, mentoring, English/computer skills, and career development training.

name_km: កម្មវិធីអាហារូបករណ៍ Adenauer Young Scholars for Excellence
note: Financial and academic support for Bachelor's and Master's students with a GPA of 3.0 or higher. Apply with a two-page CV, a motivation letter (max 700 words), and academic transcript, typically due by 30 June.

name_km: អាហារូបករណ៍ Australia Awards
note: For Master's/PhD study in Australia, aimed at future leaders who can address development challenges in Cambodia. This is a postgraduate program — most useful for students to know about now and plan toward after their first degree. Search 'Australia Awards Cambodia' for the current intake portal, since program pages change yearly.

name_km: ការបណ្តុះបណ្តាលបច្ចេកទេស និងវិជ្ជាជីវៈដោយឥតគិតថ្លៃ សម្រាប់យុវជនក្រីក្រ
name_en: Free TVET Training for Poor & Vulnerable Youth
org: Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training (MLVT) / Skills Development Fund
note: Government-funded free vocational training with monthly allowances, part of a national plan to train 1.5 million youth. Ask directly at your nearest public TVET institution (e.g. National Polytechnic Institute of Cambodia, National Technical Training Institute, or your provincial polytechnic institute).
A Cambodian platform offering scholarship listings, application tips, English learning guidance, and free mentorship for students, especially those in rural areas.

name_km: កម្មវិធីរៀបចំផែនការអាជីព Child's Dream
note: In-school career readiness coaching and scholarship-application support, currently active in Siem Reap, Battambang, and Oddar Meanchey provinces.
